providers.name: Open-Meteo

auth.notes: Public endpoints do not require an API key; verify current usage terms for the intended workload.

cost.notes: Treat commercial/high-volume plans as separate opt-in providers, never an automatic fallback.

providers.reviewNotes: Preferred no-key weather seed. Project integration still needs its own timeout/cache/e2e evidence.

providers.name: Frankfurter

auth.notes: Public API requires no API key.

cost.notes: Open source and self-hostable; do not silently switch to a paid FX feed.

providers.reviewNotes: Useful for indicative/reference exchange-rate workflows; not an execution or trading-price authority.

providers.name: World Bank Indicators API

auth.notes: World Bank documents V2 API access without API keys.

providers.reviewNotes: Authoritative macro/public-data source; preserve indicator/source metadata and dates.

providers.name: Crossref REST API

auth.notes: Anonymous public access is supported; polite identification with contact information is recommended.

cost.notes: Premium Metadata Plus must never be auto-selected.

policy.notes: Prefer a descriptive User-Agent/mailto when the consuming host can supply it.

providers.reviewNotes: Strong metadata source; verify claims against primary publications when material.

providers.name: Open Library APIs

auth.notes: Public low-volume APIs; identified clients receive more generous rate limits.

policy.notes: Not a bulk/high-traffic backend. Use data dumps for bulk workloads and identify the application for frequent requests.

providers.reviewNotes: Use only for human-facing, low-volume discovery/lookup unless the project adopts Open Library's bulk-access path.

providers.name: Wikimedia / MediaWiki Action API

auth.notes: Many read requests work without authentication; authenticated flows are separate and require project approval.

policy.notes: Use an informative User-Agent/Api-User-Agent, make considerate serial requests, batch where possible, and cache.

providers.reviewNotes: General knowledge evidence source, not project source of truth.

providers.name: GitHub REST API

auth.notes: Public reads can be unauthenticated at lower rate limits; authenticated requests require least-privilege credentials.

policy.notes: Writes are never authorized by this registry; use project/GitHub permission gates.

providers.reviewNotes: Use authenticated host connectors when available instead of duplicating credentials or raw API plumbing.

providers.name: Gemini Developer API

auth.notes: Use a project-scoped key and current Google AI Studio / Gemini API eligibility.

cost.notes: Only models/operations currently available in the official free tier are eligible for zero-cost routing.

policy.notes: Model availability, quotas, data-use terms, and region eligibility can change; verify before each production activation.

health.notes: Credentialed model discovery/inference must be checked by the consuming host without exposing secrets.

providers.reviewNotes: Preferred official free-tier AI candidate where DHP policy allows it; no paid-tier overflow.

providers.name: Hugging Face Inference Providers

auth.notes: Requires a Hugging Face user token for routed requests.

cost.notes: Free-user monthly inference credits are small and explicitly subject to change; never purchase credits automatically.

policy.notes: Route only models/providers whose current license, safety, capability, and free allowance match the task.

health.notes: Credentialed provider/model availability must be checked by the host.

providers.reviewNotes: Useful vendor-neutral experimental AI route, but free allowance is not sized for production by default.

providers.name: OpenRouter Free Models

auth.notes: Use only an explicit free-model route and a project-controlled key.

cost.notes: The free plan/free models have low limits and are not assumed production-grade. Paid models are out of route unless separately enabled by project policy.

policy.notes: Re-check free model/provider/data policies at runtime; do not let auto-routing select a paid model.

health.notes: Credentialed model-list/free-route checks belong in the consuming host.

providers.reviewNotes: Fallback/experimentation only under hard free-model filters and rate-limit handling.

providers.name: Cloudflare Workers AI

auth.notes: Requires a Cloudflare account plus account/project binding and a least-privilege token.

cost.notes: Workers Free currently includes a daily Workers AI allocation; some models require a paid plan, so model eligibility must be checked before routing.

policy.notes: Free allocation and model eligibility are mutable. Deny models that require billing under $0-first policy.

health.notes: Account/model-specific health checks require host credentials and current model selection.

providers.reviewNotes: Potential edge AI fallback; never assume every model is free-plan eligible.
